purpose: Does an agent holding the skill answer Phase 2 specifics the way the plugin contracts require? Options are shuffled per run (the key is always B in this file) and kept similar in length so a letter or length bias cannot score. Baseline (no skill) must be clearly lower than with the skill, otherwise the question measures nothing.

questions.q: What is the default maximum of unique character assets for a fresh production unless an exception reason exists?

options.D: One per scene, no cap overall.

questions.q: Two recurring characters visible together intentionally share one hair_id. Which authoring field must justify it for every colliding character?

options.D: Nothing; matching hair is always allowed.

questions.q: Which style token id and handmade profile must every production asset carry?
Which caption font stack does the channel design lock use?
What happens to experience_profile when production.json / Job@5 is produced?

options.A: It is copied into production.json for the renderer.
options.B: It is authoring-only and never projected.
options.C: It is hashed into the cover.
options.D: It is projected only for payoff scenes.

questions.q: Fresh per-beat visual coverage decides use or explicit omission for which lanes?

options.B: Actor, scene_accent, story_visual, ordinary prop, support, caption and meme, each with a reference or a reason.

questions.q: How is a fresh scene_accent serialized for Job@5 / the renderer?

options.A: Visual role background with asset category environment; not counted as prop or effect.
options.B: Visual role prop with category prop, counted in prop density.
options.C: Visual role effect with category effect.
options.D: Visual role overlay with category overlay.

questions.q: Which list is the complete set of experience_profile.story_mode values?

options.A: behavior, relationship, exposition, transition, reflection, payoff, symbolic.
options.B: action, dialogue, exposition, transition, reflection, punchline.

questions.q: Roughly what share of the pre-caption story field must story entities occupy to pass frame occupancy?
A Director blocking uses side 'between'. What else is required, and what bounds offset_px?

options.A: A distinct secondary_anchor; offset_px is 0 to 180.
options.B: A third character; offset_px is 0 to 500.
options.D: A scene accent id; offset_px is 0 to 60.

questions.q: What must a changed-state slide event satisfy?

options.A: A real near binding, finite on-canvas endpoints, unchanged size/scale/rotation and 24 to 360 px of travel.
options.B: Only a start and end frame.
options.C: Any distance up to 1920 px, size may change.
options.D: A camera move on the same frame.

questions.q: How thick is the warm-white sticker edge under a character's ink, at 1080 px?
Which runtime brand overlay is canonical?

options.A: "bungmoto" bottom-right, baked into the character SVGs.
options.B: "✦ bungmoto" top-left, runtime-owned, never baked into assets.
options.C: "Zodiac 12" top-center, baked into the cover only.

questions.q: Which caption limits does the design token set?

options.A: Default 56 px, minimum 48 px, at most two lines, semantic pagination.
options.B: Default 84 px, minimum 72 px, at most four lines, fixed 6-word slices.
options.C: Default 40 px, minimum 24 px, one line.
options.D: Any size; fixed word counts per caption.

questions.q: What does the compiler do when a fresh narrative intent selects a scene_set_id?

options.A: Accepts it and renders the wall backdrop.
options.B: Rejects it (the fresh Scene Set is retired).
options.D: Converts it to a Scene Accent.

questions.q: What does a selected meme adapter need in a beat's coverage to count as used?

options.B: Reacting character entity_ids, the adapter, state_bindings and its actual anchored reaction in the beat's event_ids.
options.C: A story visual in the same beat.
options.D: A flag set once for the episode.

questions.q: Who can grant Visual Review, and what does a native validator PASS mean?

options.A: The validator grants it automatically on PASS.
options.B: Only a genuine user message grants it; PASS is structure evidence, never approval.
options.C: The agent grants it after a preview renders.
options.D: CI grants it on a green build.

questions.q: Narration text changes after Phase 2 has started. What reopens?

options.B: Content and visuals, including voice anchors and timing.
